# ApkZio Starter Template

Modern Android WebView application template built with Kotlin and Material Design 3.

## 🎯 What This Is

This is the **ApkZio Starter Template** - a production-ready Android app template that wraps any website into a native Android application.

**Generated by:** [ApkZio - Free Android App Builder](https://apkzio.com/)

## ✨ Features

- **Kotlin** with modern Android development practices
- **Material Design 3** UI components
- **WebView** with advanced features:
  - File uploads (camera, gallery)
  - Geolocation support
  - Camera access
  - Pull-to-refresh
  - Swipe navigation
  - Offline error handling
- **ViewBinding** for type-safe view access
- **AndroidX** libraries
- **Gradle 8.7+** build system
- **ProGuard** optimization rules

## 📦 Template Variables

The following tokens are replaced during build:

| Token | Description | Example |
|-------|-------------|---------|
| `{{APP_NAME}}` | Application name | "My Awesome App" |
| `{{PACKAGE_NAME}}` | Java package name | "com.example.myapp" |
| `{{START_URL}}` | Website URL to load | "https://example.com" |
| `{{PRIMARY_COLOR}}` | Primary theme color | "#3B82F6" |
| `{{BACKGROUND_COLOR}}` | Background color | "#FFFFFF" |
| `{{SPLASH_COLOR}}` | Splash screen color | "#3B82F6" |
| `{{VERSION_CODE}}` | Build version number | 1 |
| `{{VERSION_NAME}}` | Version string | "1.0.0" |
| `{{OFFLINE_MESSAGE}}` | Offline error message | "No internet connection" |
| `__PACKAGE_PATH__` | Package directory path | "com/example/myapp" |

## 🔧 Conditional Features

Features can be toggled using HTML-style conditionals:

```xml
<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.READ_MEDIA_IMAGES" />
```

Available conditionals:
- `ALLOW_FILE_UPLOADS`
- `ALLOW_GEOLOCATION`
- `ALLOW_CAMERA`
- `PULL_TO_REFRESH`
- `SWIPE_BACK`

## 🏗️ Building

### Via ApkZio Platform (Recommended)

1. Go to [ApkZio.com](https://apkzio.com/) or [Admin Dashboard](https://admin.apkzio.com/)
2. Enter your app details
3. Click "Build APK"
4. Download your ready-to-install APK file

### Manual Build

```bash
# Build debug APK
./gradlew assembleDebug

# Output: app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
```

## 📱 Installation

```bash
# Install on connected device
adb install app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
```

Or transfer the APK to your device and install manually (enable "Install from Unknown Sources").

## 🎨 Customization

### Update Colors

Edit `app/src/main/res/values/colors.xml`:

```xml
<color name="primary">#3B82F6</color>
<color name="background">#FFFFFF</color>
<color name="splash">#3B82F6</color>
```

### Update App Icon

Replace launcher icons in:
- `app/src/main/res/mipmap-*/ic_launcher.xml`
- `app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_launcher_foreground.xml`

### Modify WebView Behavior

Edit `app/src/main/java/__PACKAGE_PATH__/MainActivity.kt`
